_meta.description: Behavioural detection rules for PowerShell macro, WMI lateral movement, and certutil abuse.

rules.name: PowerShell launched from Office application
rules.description: powershell.exe spawned directly by an Office process — classic macro delivery.

rules.name: PowerShell encoded command (-enc / -EncodedCommand)
rules.description: Base64-encoded payload passed via -enc or -EncodedCommand — primary obfuscation method.

rules.name: PowerShell hidden window + no-profile flags
rules.description: Combination of -NoProfile/-nop and -WindowStyle Hidden strongly suggests non-interactive malicious execution.

rules.name: PowerShell execution-policy bypass
rules.description: Explicit execution-policy bypass used to circumvent PowerShell script restrictions.

rules.name: PowerShell download cradle (IEX + DownloadString)
rules.description: In-memory download-and-execute cradle — payload never touches disk.

rules.name: PowerShell AMSI bypass attempt
rules.description: Reflection-based AMSI initialisation bypass — indicates awareness of AV evasion.

rules.name: PowerShell registry Run-key persistence
rules.description: Set-ItemProperty targeting CurrentVersion\Run establishes user-level persistence.

rules.name: WmiPrvSE.exe spawning command-line process
rules.description: WmiPrvSE.exe spawning cmd/powershell/net/reg is the hallmark of WMI lateral movement.

rules.name: wmic.exe remote node execution (/node: flag)
rules.description: wmic.exe used with /node: to remotely create a process — core WMI lateral-movement technique.

rules.name: wmic.exe credentials in command line
rules.description: Clear-text credentials (/user: /password:) in wmic command line — credential theft/reuse indicator.

rules.name: WMI process call create
rules.description: Win32_Process.Create called via wmic — standard WMI remote-process-creation method.

rules.name: WMI service creation via wmic
rules.description: wmic.exe used to create a new service — persistent implant technique.

rules.name: WmiPrvSE.exe spawning scheduled task creation
rules.description: WMI-initiated schtasks.exe execution — lateral movement combined with persistence.

rules.name: certutil -urlcache download
rules.description: certutil.exe abused to download a remote file via -urlcache — quintessential LOLBAS technique.

rules.name: certutil Base64 decode
rules.description: certutil -decode transforms a Base64 blob into a binary — second stage of download-decode-execute.

rules.name: certutil hex decode (-decodehex)
rules.description: certutil -decodehex variant of payload decoding.

rules.name: certutil download-decode-execute chain
rules.description: Single command containing both -urlcache and -decode confirms full download-then-execute chain.

rules.name: certutil writing to suspicious output path
rules.description: certutil output targeting writable system paths (temp, programdata, system32) — payload staging location.

rules.name: certutil launched from scripting host
rules.description: certutil.exe spawned by a scripting host (wscript, cscript, mshta, powershell) — script-based delivery.

rules.name: Executable dropped to Windows Temp
rules.description: Executable dropped to the Windows temp directory — common staging location for second-stage payloads.

rules.name: Local admin account creation via net.exe
rules.description: net.exe used to add a user to the local administrators group.

rules.name: Scheduled task creation from script context
rules.description: schtasks.exe /create launched from a scripting context — often used for persistence.

rules.name: Registry Run-key modification via reg.exe
rules.description: reg.exe adding/modifying a Run/RunOnce key — persistent auto-start mechanism.
